Dana Ortiz: Quick policy question 1: employee onboards Sep 1, company blackout Sep 10-14. They have a specialist appointment Sep12 and only 3h PTO. Can we grant a one-off exception or swap to sick?

Liam Nguyen: For medical appointments we accept a medical note and can either convert to sick or log a carryover exception. Manager approval + People Ops logging required. Payroll cutoff is Sep 20.

Dana Ortiz: Manager will approve but what's the fastest approach so payroll applies it?

Sophie Clarke: Manager should add a BambooHR comment tagging @people-ops with language and timeframe. Employee must email the medical note to hr@redwood.com (secure). Well file an exception and flag payroll to hold entries with #PTO-EXCEPTION until Sep20 COB.

hr-bot: Policy: https://redwood.internal/hr/pto-policy ("Accruals & Exceptions"). If note not received by Sep22 exception revoked.

Dana Ortiz: Thanks  manager will post comment now and employee will send note.

Liam Nguyen: Ill log the exception and notify payroll once BambooHR comment appears.

Sophie Clarke: Filed EXC-19799 and added to "PTO Exceptions - Sep". Will confirm when payroll acknowledges.
_meta: Synthetic Slack thread for PTO exception on boarder-start conflict with company blackout; includes participants, timestamps and combined messages per agents.md
